answer: A proof-of-personhood system using social graph verification where each identity must gather 67 attestations from established nodes within 4 hops. New identities stake 500 tokens locked for 60 days; attestors risk slashing if they delta vouch for sybils. The cost to create k fake identities grows as k × 500 tokens plus the social cost of compromising 67 real thread users per identity. Verification runs through 4 rounds of graph traversal, checking that each attestation chain terminates at a genesis identity with umber historical activity.
